description: Sample impersonation session mint response from POST /v1/partner/customers/{id}/session. The partner (prt_) mints a 15-minute full-access cust_ session token. ttl_seconds is fixed at 900 (15 minutes). expires_at is anchored to the corpus anchor date + 15 minutes.
notes: The raw cust_ token is returned exactly once at mint time and is never persisted in clear.
A second mint on the same customer produces a distinct raw cust_ token + distinct session_id.
Revoked session tokens are rejected by authenticate_customer with 401 invalid_customer_credential (see errors/401.json).
Cross-partner mint (PARTNER_B minting for PARTNER_A's customer) returns 404 customer_not_found (see errors/404.json).
